progress_note: Fix1 was rerun on Windows Godot 4.7.1 stable double a13da4feb. The core FirstPersonEmbodiment contract passed cleanly with 23 assertions and the fail-closed runner correctly reported PASS. The subsequent graphical launch exposed a separate composition parse failure: quaternius_first_person_embodiment_lab.gd inherited the accepted QuaterniusPlayableNetworkEquipmentLab script and Godot could not resolve that class in this loading path; two dynamic-return variables also used unsupported inferred typing. Fix2 removes the research inheritance boundary entirely. The FPE scene now composes the accepted quaternius_playable_network_equipment_lab.tscn as child CH9_6BaseLab and accesses it as an external runtime owner. Explicit String/Variant typing replaces the two failing inferred variables. A new test_first_person_embodiment_lab_load.gd preloads and instantiates the exact graphical scene without entering the tree, and RUN_FPE_RESEARCH_TESTS.ps1 now requires both the 23-assertion core contract and the graphical scene-load smoke test to pass before PLAY is attempted. Canonical item/network authority remains unchanged and fail-closed.
